dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Pronounced geometric narrowing from the mid-section to a sharp, acute point at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical bulging on the left lateral margin; the right margin exhibits a more continuous, smooth convex curve.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance indicative of a depigmented dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A series of small, dark, high-contrast punctate marks are visible along the posterior midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Multiple transverse linear depressions (rake-like scarring) crossing the central dorsal axis on the posterior third of the visible body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct horizontal linear scarring (likely rake marks) across the posterior dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark circular mark located on the anterior dorsal head region.
